dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: DYT6 (THAP1-related) isolated dystonia due to a heterozygous pathogenic nonsense variant in THAP1 (c.505C>T, p.Arg169*)

Alternatives to consider:
1. Idiopathic adult-onset cervical dystonia with coincidental THAP1 variant of uncertain significance
2. Wilson's disease (excluded by normal copper studies and slit-lamp examination)
3. Dystonia secondary to a structural brainstem or basal ganglia lesion (excluded by normal MRI)
